settings.title: Jarvis
settings.intro: The assistant's character and conversation mode: how Jarvis addresses you, which model it talks with and how much it remembers.
settings.personaHint: A polite, calm, slightly dry tone in every reply. Turn it off for neutral replies without a form of address.
settings.greetHint: "Good morning, sir" when Orkestr starts and on the first request of the day.
settings.localTemplatesHint: Greetings, time, date, jokes and other common phrases are answered from a local bank (Russian) — no tokens.
settings.bankStats: The bank holds {{intents}} topics, {{questions}} question phrasings and {{answers}} reply variants.
settings.modelDefault: Same as the AI Manager (with the fallback chain)
settings.modelHint: If a subscription or key fails, the reply moves on to the next provider automatically.
settings.memoryHint: How many recent messages the model sees in every reply. The history is stored on this computer.
settings.projectContextHint: The model gets your project names and the number of running tasks to answer questions about them.

mode.label: Mode
mode.commandsHint: I run commands; an unknown task goes to the AI planner.
mode.chatHint: Talk with the AI; commands like "open YouTube" still run.
